proof_boundary.enumeration_proves: For fixed queried handle edges and a uniformly random hidden relabeling, public strict-order bits have the same distribution for every strict underlying order for n<=4.
proof_boundary.enumeration_does_not_prove: Joint simulation of local shares, per-party shuffle state/messages, correlated multi-instance DCF materials/access trace, adaptive edge selection, abort, or output shares.
